_help: Hand fixes for matching parks.geojson to OpenStreetMap, keyed by park id. Use one of: {"osm": ["way/123", "relation/456"]} to name the exact OSM outlines; {"trail": "Steamboat Ditch Trail"} to use segments with that name near the pin; {"radius_m": 600} to use a circle around the pin. Add an optional "note". Rerun `npm run build:parks` after editing.
